BiblicalUsage: Ginnethon is a person named 3 times in Scripture, in Nehemiah. The full story lives on the Ginnethon profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Ginnethon in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
